name: kettlebell one arm clean and jerk
description: You clean a kettlebell to your shoulder, then dip and drive it overhead with one arm. A full body power move for legs, shoulders and core.
instructions: Stand with one kettlebell in hand and your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Hinge and swing the bell back between your legs, then extend your hips to clean it into the rack at your shoulder.
With the bell settled in the rack, make a short knee dip and drive through your legs to send it upward.
Move slightly under the bell and lock your arm overhead before standing fully.
Lower the bell to the rack and reset, then switch arms after the set.
